# YesChat.ai

> > YesChat.ai is an all-in-one AI platform offering cutting-edge models like DeepSeek, GPT-4o, Claude, and specialized tools for chat, image generation, video creation, and content transformation.

The platform integrates leading AI technologies including OpenAI, PixVerse, Alibaba's Tongyi Lab, and open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. YesChat.ai provides both conversational AI capabilities and creative tools for generating images, videos, and visual effects across multiple languages.

## Key Topics

- DeepSeek V3.1 - Open-source MoE language model
- PixVerse - AI video and image generation engine
- Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) - Advanced AI architecture
- Wan 2.2 - Alibaba's open-source video generation model
- Kimi K2 - Moonshot AI's coding and reasoning model
- OpenAI GPT models - Foundation language models
- AI video generation - Text/image-to-video creation
- AI image generation - Text-to-image synthesis
- Midjourney - Discord-based image generation
- Character consistency - Maintaining visual identity across frames
- Cinematic video - Professional-grade AI filmmaking
- Open-source AI - Apache 2.0 and freely available models
- Image-to-video - Photo animation and transformation
- Social media content - AI-powered content creation
- Nano Banana - Image processing and restoration tool

## AI Models & Core Features

- [YesChat.ai: Cutting-Edge AI Models for Chat, Music, and Video](https://www.yeschat.ai): All-in-one AI platform with DeepSeek-R1, GPT-4o, Claude for content creation

- [Kimi K2: El modelo de Mezcla de Expertos de código abierto definitivo para programación y razonamiento](https://yeschat.ai/es/features/kimi-k2): Moonshot AI's Kimi K2 1T parameter MoE model for coding and reasoning
- [Wan 2.2: A Free Open-Source MoE Model for High-Fidelity Cinematic AI Video](https://yeschat.ai/features/wan-2-2): Alibaba Tongyi's Wan 2.2 open-source MoE for text/image-to-video
- [OpenAI's New OPEN Models - GPT-OSS 120B & 20B](https://www.yeschat.ai/blog-openais-new-open-models-gptoss-120b-20b-54583): OpenAI's Apache 2.0 licensed GPT-OSS models for local deployment
